tempest_threat.description: Hostile AI receives a repeating Great Tempest power.

greedy.description: Each victory gives 25% more Gems than normal. You start the run with no Ore at all, whatever your upgrades or other modifiers would grant.

veteran_economy.description: Each victory gives 40% more Ore than normal, but 30% fewer Gems.

poor_logistics.description: Run-shop prices are 25% lower, but everything you build takes 25% longer.

generous_command.description: You start with 125 extra Ore, but each victory gives 20% fewer Gems than normal. Saved Gems are never removed.

blind_choice.description: Each victory gives 20% more Ore, but every mission offer hides its class, reward tier, exact reward, and bonus until it is launched.

glass_cannon.description: Player units deal 25% more damage but have 20% less durability.

overclocked_factories.description: Production time is 25% shorter, but player unit and structure costs are 20% higher.

black_market.description: Each mission has 4 extra Shop offers, but run-shop prices are 25% higher.

elite_force.description: Remaining guaranteed starters begin Veteran, while one infantry and one tank starter slot are removed.

no_safety_net.description: Each victory gives 10 extra Gems, but rerolls, difficulty assists, and Emergency Revival are disabled.

support_doctrine.description: Aid powers recharge 30% faster, but combat units build 20% slower.

war_economy.description: Start with 125 extra Ore, but every mission starts with 3,000 fewer in-game Credits.

narrow_intelligence.description: Mission victories give 30% more Ore, but you are offered only 2 missions to choose from.

liquid_assets.description: Run-shop prices are 20% lower, but unused Ore disappears after each mission victory.

treasure_hunter.description: Challenge missions give double base Gems, but normal missions give 25% less Ore.

campaign_units.description: Hide story units that no skirmish game can build: prototypes, boss brutes, retired Red Alert 2 hardware, and one-off heroes.

campaign_powers.description: Hide support powers that exist only inside scripted missions.

superweapons.description: Hide game-ending superweapons and keep the run on ordinary support powers.
